raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer falsely claimed that Wikipedia states Waylon Jennings was buried in Chandler at “Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery,” without evidence from the page view and in contradiction to earlier verified information (Find a Grave showing City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona, and the Wikipedia City of Mesa Cemetery page listing Jennings as a notable interment). This appears to conflate place of death (Chandler) with place of burial and introduces a hallucinated cemetery detail, creating a misleading conflict.
